task: YOINK-01 | Preserve missing latency as missing data
deliveryState: Reviewable uncommitted changes in the assigned workspace; no merge, release, external send or live data change.
implementation: Both repositories use one shared latency validator and percentile summarizer; only bounded integer numeric measurements count, including genuine zero.
NULL, absent values, booleans, strings, non-finite numbers, fractions, negative durations and out-of-range durations remain missing.
Timestamps require valid timezone-qualified ISO strings with real calendar dates; missing, invalid, reversed and out-of-range pairs do not yield a sample.
Browser phases require a valid lease event timestamp; a valid stored lease-to-cart duration wins even when it is zero, otherwise a valid lease-to-confirmation pair within one hour is used.
The confirmation fallback excludes shopper checkout reports and corrections; missing click/baseline/offer/settle hops are never inferred from other phases.
Admin JSON and CSV expose valid per-hop samples and p50/p95, job cohort size and outcome/store/recorded extension and adapter version breakdowns.
Unknown version tags remain null; versions are read from historical action-event evidence, never from current device metadata.
Both repositories order tied creation times by job ID so the capped 500-job cohort is deterministic.

reportingContract.jsonBreakdowns: analytics.latency.breakdowns[] contains outcome, retailerId, extensionVersion, adapterVersion, jobsSampled and hops.
reportingContract.outcomeMeaning: Latest shopper-reported outcome (including corrections), otherwise current action job state.
reportingContract.csvCompatibility: The original first five columns remain in place; three dimension columns are appended and all rows have eight columns.
reportingContract.missingValues: Null percentiles are blank in CSV; true zero is 0; every hop has its own samples count.

acceptance.criterion: NULL/missing/invalid timestamps do not enter percentiles as zero
acceptance.evidence: Shared-helper edge cases plus persisted partial evidence and a 504-job repository/export fixture.

acceptance.criterion: True zero latency remains distinguishable from missing data
acceptance.evidence: Numeric zero survives persistence, per-job reporting, percentiles, grouped stats and CSV; missing samples yield null percentiles.

acceptance.criterion: Focused tests cover partial hops, fallback timestamps and reporting/export denominators
acceptance.evidence: 42 focused tests pass, including five shared-helper tests, three new repository/export tests and existing signal/admin API/UI coverage.

regressionExamples.beforeFix: The partial-evidence fixture returned leaseToCartReadyMs=0 instead of the supported 60000 timestamp fallback.
regressionExamples.sampleCap: 504 total jobs, 500 sampled jobs, 500 jobs in the relevant breakdown, and zero valid samples/null percentiles for absent hops; user insights and admin export agree.

limitations: The complete repository suite is not claimed green: 20 unrelated checkout-report fixture failures reproduce at the original HEAD.

Detailed breakdowns are exposed through the admin JSON endpoint and CSV; the existing admin screen continues to show the aggregate hop summaries.
This deliverable validates local persistence/reporting behavior, not live retailer execution or phone-delivery latency.
